plan.root_cause: The radios component only updates ARIA attributes and conditional visibility on click events, not on keyboard-driven change events, causing the conditional content to remain visible when navigating away via arrow keys.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a change event listener that invokes the same attribute-update logic used for clicks, ensuring that selecting a radio via keyboard updates aria-expanded and toggles the associated conditional panel.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now navigate the radio group with arrow keys and see conditional fields show/hide appropriately, meeting WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Potential duplicate handling if both click and change fire for the same interaction (e.g., mouse click may trigger both); however setAttributes is idempotent.
Slight performance overhead from iterating all radios on each change, but negligible given typical small radio groups.
verification_requirements: Verify that arrowing between options updates aria-expanded and hides/shows conditionals correctly.
Verify that mouse clicks continue to work as before.
Verify that form data reflects the selected value after keyboard navigation.
Verify no regression in existing tests for the radios component.

plan.root_cause: The radios component only updates ARIA attributes and conditional visibility on click events, not on keyboard-driven change events. When navigating with arrow keys between radio options, a 'change' event fires but 'click' does not, so conditional fields remain visible when they should be hidden.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a 'change' event listener that invokes the same attribute-update logic used for clicks, ensuring that selecting a radio via keyboard updates aria-expanded and toggles the associated conditional panel.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now navigate the radio group with arrow keys and see conditional fields show/hide appropriately, meeting WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Potential duplicate handling if both click and change fire for the same interaction (e.g., mouse click may trigger both); however setAttributes is idempotent.
Slight performance overhead from iterating all radios on each change, but negligible given typical small radio groups.
verification_requirements: Verify that arrowing between options updates aria-expanded and hides/shows conditionals correctly.
Verify that mouse clicks continue to work as before.
Verify that form data reflects the selected value after keyboard navigation.
Verify no regression in existing tests for the radios component.

plan.root_cause: The radios component only listens for click events on its own module element. When a radio in a different module (but same radio group) is selected via keyboard, the change event does not bubble to the first module, so its conditional fields are not updated.
plan.repair_strategy: Make each Radios instance listen for click and change events on the document, and filter by the radio group name. This ensures that selection changes in any module of the same group trigger updates for all modules.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can navigate between radio options across modules and see conditional fields show/hide correctly, meeting WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Potential performance overhead from global event listeners; however, the component is lightweight and the filtering minimizes unnecessary work.
Risk of duplicate handling if multiple Radios instances exist for the same group, but setAttributes is idempotent.
verification_requirements: Verify that arrowing between options updates aria-expanded and hides/shows conditionals correctly.
Verify that mouse clicks continue to work as before.
Verify that form data reflects the selected value after keyboard navigation.
Verify no regression in existing tests for the radios component.
